nom: Embryolisse Lait-Crème Concentré Sensitive Face Moisturizer and Makeup Primer, Hypoallergenic Fragrance-Free Face Cream with Aloe Vera and Shea Butter

avis.titre: A Primer and Moisturizer in OneA Primer and Moisturizer in One
avis.texte: I think this is my 9th or 10th bottle so far, and I don’t see myself stopping anytime soon. I used to be a big fan of La Roche-Posay, but the moisture level was too much for my skin, it clogged my pores and occasionally caused breakouts. Switching to Embryolisse Lait Crème Sensitive has been a total game changer. Here’s why I love it: • Perfectly moisturizes without greasiness: It absorbs immediately into the skin, leaving it hydrated but never shiny or sticky. • Doubles as a primer: It smooths out my skin, minimizes the appearance of large pores, and creates the perfect base for makeup. • Great for sensitive skin: No irritation, just lightweight, soothing hydration thanks to its gentle, natural ingredients. • Value for money: A little goes a long way, and the quality you get for the price is unbeatable. If you’re looking for a moisturizer that’s effective, non-greasy, and sensitive-skin-friendly, this is it. Truly worth every penny!

I finally found my holy grail!!! I was on the hunt for a moisturizer to use with tretinoin that wasn't greasy but still super hydrating. Before this I tried LRP Toleriane moisturizer and it burned my skin so bad, I threw that in the garbage. This doesn’t burn at all. It’s lightweight but extremely moisturizing especially while using tret, my face is never dry. I read you can double this as a make up primer too, will be trying that next. Embryolisse leaves my skin feeling buttery soft without that greasy/oily residue. And to top it all off it comes in a cute aluminum tube - I love it! Get it!!

avis.titre: Hydrating and Moisturizing without the signature Embryolise scent
avis.texte: Four stars only for the packaging. It is in a metal tube with a plastic cap. I would really appreciate if this came with a key to turn the tube. Must buy separately. Aside from this, the cream is rather enjoyable and does a very good job moisturizing. I just could not stand the scent of the cleanser, so I decided to get the sensitive version of this moisturizer to avoid the terrible fragrance. It is very moisturizing and leaves a bit of a glossy sheen on the skin, great for dry skin and those who want to look moisturized. It helps my skin feel comfortable through the entire day and even at work in the hospital for 12 hour shifts. It is very difficult to keep skin hydrated and moisturized for that long in hospital air! It is a bit spendy, but quite a hearty amount and you really don’t need much of this at all. I would repurchase again without any kind of budget constraints, otherwise I would select the Vanicream Facial Moisturizer alternatively. Though thinner in texture, it has a very comparable finish.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer and makeup primer. Lovely finish.
avis.texte: Great under makeup on my normal/combination skin. Very moisturizing and smoothing, so you don't need a primer. For daytime, I use a moisturizing sunscreen without moisturizer underneath; but for a night out, this is what I reach for. Love it!

When I was I Paris last year, I bought this product there and loved it. I’m so glad to know I can purchase it in the USA. It is not greasy feeling without heavy fragrance. I have very sensitive skin and this product is soothing rather than irritating.
Have rebought multiple times. I have been using for over two years and my sensitive skin loves it. I use it as my morning lotion, sits well under makeup when I wear it and absorbs well.
This cream is sooo hydrating, just buy it, you won't be disappointed. Doesn't feel greasy, doesn't have fragrance, doesn't give me breakouts. I just love it ❤️

Best moisturizer ever. I got Unscented. Moisturizing so well. This is my new favorite. Love it. I haven’t try regular but unscented is amazing. Skin feeling so soft. It keep my face moisturized for all day. I used morning and night. ❤️❤️❤️❤️

I really like this moisturizer. It feels lightweight and smooth on the skin and provides good hydration without feeling too heavy. It works nicely under makeup and leaves my skin feeling soft and comfortable. A great everyday moisturizer, especially when I want something simple and gentle.
Ottima crema viso, la uso come primer make-up ed è eccezionale! Unica pecca lascia la pelle un po’ unta… ma fa durare tantissimo il make-up. Mai più senza
Me gusta mucho esta marca francesa que inexplicablemente últimamente no es fácil de encontrar en España! El producto solicitado es muy bueno y eficaz!!

I’ve purchased this twice now and can’t recommend it enough! I use it as a primer under my foundation and it does double duty as primer/moisturizer. Huge tube that lasts months. The one thing that is a bit off the mark (but not so much that I’d remove a star over) is once you get to the end of the tube, it starts to crack open (see pic). Whatever it’s made of doesn’t hold up very well, and that edge is sharp. Other than that, I have zero complaints.
I use this on all of my clients and it is amazing! I am makeup artist and this is a product that does not leave my kit.

My bridal Makeup artist used this for my wedding and my makeup was flawless, I’ve been using it since. It’s a great moisturizer and base layer for all makeup. I got the sensitive skin one because I break out easily and have had no issues. There’s no fragrance to it and the tube is quite large and lasts.

avis.titre: Soothing and reliable for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer. Other products always made my face feel tight, but this one keeps my skin comfortable all day. It’s fragrance-free, gentle, and has the perfect texture — not too thick, not runny. I’m already on my second tube!

This is a heavier lotion with lanolin in it that can clog pores in some people. I can only use this every once in a while otherwise I end up breaking out. The original was definitely heavily scented and this one totes to be unscented yet there's still a lingering medicinal scent to it that I just can't stand. If anything I think they just removed the artificial fragrance but there's still some that must be plant derived which means you guessed it, it's NOT unscented. It's not a bad product, I get why there's a cult following of it but it's not for everyone. The cap drives me crazy too. I wish it was just a flip cap because the thing goes flying off when my hands are wet. It's a 6.5 out of 10 for me.

avis.titre: This one is different from the original, it is more suitable for sensitive skin！！
avis.texte: This moisturising cream, which is made in France, is packaged in a white metal tube with a large screw on cap. The tube holds 100ml of product. The white, silky smooth cream has a medium consistency. What a versatile product this French pharmacy cream is, able to help at every stage of my skincare routine – as a cleanser, a wipe-off face mask, then a moisturizer and finally as a hydrating primer under make-up I absolutely love this cream. I've wanted to try the original for ages but thought my skin would find the fragrance to be irritating. I was ELATED to see Embryolisse come out with this version. I have dehydrated, sensitive and acne prone skin. From my experience so far, this product works pretty much with every single serum i’ve tried it with, even with more heavy duty formulas dedicated for nighttime.

Arrived today, there was a hole at the opposite end from the opening of the tube. It gushing out for a bit. I was hoping for less ingredients bc it’s for sensitive skin. I applied a little and felt a slight and mild burn sensation. For the price I was just hoping for better.

avis.titre: Bad Smell, Damaged Package & Over Priced
avis.texte: Unfortunately, I did not have a positive experience with this cream. The strong, unpleasant smell it produced was similar to that of old lotion. I was compelled to wash my face right away. Furthermore, the product arrived with damaged packaging, including a smashed box and tube. Given its high price, I expected a much better product. I would caution against purchasing this cream unless you are willing to tolerate a strong, unpleasant odor on your face. Despite my initial enthusiasm, I was ultimately disappointed with this product and plan to return it promptly.

The product is good (I’ve used before) but the shipping is terrible. Box was put with a bunch of other items just freely in the box it was all shipped in. The tube had a cutter the top of tube and lotion coming out. Have to return which is a pain!
Product arrived completely damaged and broken. The moisturizer spilled out everywhere and has now wasted product all in the package bag.
I love this cream, BUT this order came open and smashed....scary border from Amazon again. Will order direct from company next time.

avis.titre: Arrived with lotion everywhere but the inside of the tube
avis.texte: I don't know who caused this messy situation, but lotion was absolutely everywhere. The tube was bent in every direction. Much worse than the picture shows.
